environment.language: R; Python used only for OSF retrieval and file checksums

claims.claim: Experiment 1: participant judgments correlated with Bayes at r=.92, UPCO at r=-.08, and Competence at r=.79; Bayes–UPCO correlation difference t=4.51 and Bayes–Competence difference t=1.35.
Experiment 2: Fig. 4 reports correlations of participant judgments with Bayes r=.99, UPCO r=.97, and Competence r=.96.
Experiment 2: AIC comparisons show ensembles outperform individual models, with a larger gain from adding Competence than UPCO.
Experiment 3: AIC is approximately 410 for Bayes, 497 for UPCO, and 507 for Competence; Bayes is the best individual predictor and ensembles outperform it.
Experiment 3: AIC is approximately 1,722 for the proportion heuristic and 922 for the prior heuristic, both worse than the Bayesian model.
Experiment 3: Bayes best captures 43% of participants by correlations and 48% by deviations.

results.quantity: Experiment 1 correlations and paired correlation tests
results.reported: Bayes r=.92; UPCO r=-.08; Competence r=.79; Bayes–UPCO t=4.51; Bayes–Competence t=1.35
results.recomputed: Not computed: shipped script stopped before these statistics
results.fix: Replaced the hard-coded setwd path with the local OSF data directory and added an alias from the measured `belief` column to `value` before the script reuses `belief` for labels. These changes preserve measured responses and the analysis intent.
results.note: After this path and column-name repair, E1_analysis.R stopped at cor.test.default(ofq, bfq): 'x' and 'y' must have the same length. The claim was not computed.

results.reported: Bayes r=.99; UPCO r=.97; Competence r=.96
results.recomputed: Not computed by the shipped script
results.note: The script creates the predictions and model-comparison regressions but does not compute or print the three Pearson correlations reported in Fig. 4. No additional correlation analysis was written for this check.

results.reported: Ensembles outperform individual models; adding Competence improves ensemble prediction more than adding UPCO
results.recomputed: AIC (Bayes, Competence, UPCO, C+U, B+U, B+C, B+C+U) = -890.393, -569.659, -633.520, -659.979, -1039.405, -1139.647, -1149.107; all-model ensemble is best; Competence gives the larger improvement
results.fix: Changed only the hard-coded working directory to the OSF data directory and installed packages required by the shipped script. The model specifications, data, and filters were unchanged.

results.quantity: Experiment 3 AIC for Bayes, UPCO, Competence and best ensemble
results.reported: Bayes≈410; UPCO≈497; Competence≈507; Bayes best single model; an ensemble outperforms individual models
results.recomputed: Bayes=463.148; UPCO=569.755; Competence=785.130; Bayes+C=322.711 is best overall
results.fix: Changed only the hard-coded working directory to the OSF data directory and installed packages required by the shipped script, including Hmisc for plotting summaries. The model specifications, data, and filters were unchanged.
results.note: Individual-model AIC gaps are +53.148 (Bayes), +72.755 (UPCO), and +278.130 (Competence), relative to the manuscript's approximations. The ordering claim recurs: Bayes is the best individual predictor and Bayes+C is the best listed model.

findings.description: Experiment 1 does not reach its reported model correlations and tests. After path and measured-column naming repairs, the analysis stops because the vectors passed to cor.test have different lengths; the underlying source of that misalignment is not identified here.
findings.evidence: E1_analysis.R exits at cor.test.default(ofq, bfq) with 'x' and 'y' must have the same length; see logs/E1_analysis.log.
findings.suggested_fix: Reconcile the vectors for the same 18 stimuli in the shipped Experiment 1 analysis, then rerun the supplied data.

findings.description: Experiment 3’s individual model AIC values and proportion-heuristic AIC do not recur, although the stated model ordering does. The cause of the manuscript/script value mismatch is unresolved in this check.
findings.evidence: Shipped script returns Bayes=463.148, UPCO=569.755, Competence=785.130, proportion=1766.298, prior=922.169; manuscript reports approximately 410, 497, 507, 1722, and 922.
findings.suggested_fix: Reconcile the analysis/data filtering that produced the manuscript AICs with E3_analysis.R and rerun the supplied data.

findings.description: Experiment 2’s script creates the model predictions and regressions but omits the Pearson correlation calculations printed in Fig. 4, so those exact claims are not generated by the shipped analysis.
findings.evidence: E2_analysis.R computes the model regressions and AICs but contains no correlation test for the Fig. 4 values; see logs/E2_analysis.log and logs/E2_outputs.log.
findings.suggested_fix: Include the manuscript's correlation calculation in the shipped analysis and rerun it with the supplied data.

findings.description: Pilot 1 stops in boot.ci because the confidence-interval calculation reaches a missing-value logical condition; the upstream cause is unresolved.
findings.evidence: pilot1_analysis.R exits from boot.ci with 'missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed'; see logs/pilot1_analysis.log.
findings.suggested_fix: Resolve the bootstrap interval failure in the supplied pilot script and rerun the original pilot data.

findings.description: The Experiment 3 pilot script stops at a model call that contains no random-effects terms, which lme4 rejects.
findings.evidence: E3pilot_analysis.R exits with 'No random effects terms specified in formula'; see logs/E3pilot_analysis.log.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the supplied model call or its intended model class, then rerun the pilot analysis.

findings.description: The original scripts specify placeholder or machine-specific working directories, so the supplied OSF data cannot be found until those paths are normalized.
findings.evidence: Path-only substitutions were required in all six working copies to read the downloaded OSF datasets; original files were preserved outside the certification bundle and their listed SHA-256 hashes were checked.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a project-relative data path or accept a data-directory argument in the scripts.

limitations: The OSF data were downloaded for local execution and kept outside the certification bundle; only links and SHA-256 identifiers are recorded here.

All six shipped analysis scripts were run. Pilot analyses are not separate claims in the main article; Pilot 1 and the Experiment 3 pilot script terminate with errors, while Pilot 2 exits successfully.
This check assesses computational reproducibility only; scientific correctness and robustness were not assessed.
